<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">2. if, on a pro forma basis
after giving effect to such Equity Distribution, Borrowing Base Deficiency, any Default or Event of Default is occurring, continuing
or would result or increase therefrom;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">3. in the case of Interest
Proceeds, the Borrower certifies in such notice that, after giving effect to such Equity Distribution and all prior Equity Distributions
since the immediately preceding Payment Date (or, the Closing Date, if no Payment Date has yet occurred), the Interest Proceeds projected
to be remaining in the Interest Collection Account will be equal to or exceed the aggregate amounts necessary to pay all amounts payable
pursuant to subclauses (1)&nbsp;through (8)&nbsp;in the Interest Priority of Payments on the immediately succeeding Payment Date;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">4. in the case of Principal
Proceeds, the Borrower certifies in such notice that, after giving effect to such Equity Distribution and all prior Equity Distributions
since the immediately preceding Payment Date (or, the Closing Date, if no Payment Date has yet occurred), the Principal Proceeds projected
to be remaining in the Principal Collection Account will be equal to or exceed the aggregate amounts necessary to pay all projected amounts
payable pursuant to subclauses (1)&nbsp;through (7)&nbsp;in the Principal Priority of Payments on the immediately succeeding Payment
Date; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">5. to the extent such Equity
Distribution or payment would otherwise be made out of proceeds of Loans made hereunder, and at such time a Borrower Entity is Committed
to Acquire one or more Collateral Obligations but such Collateral Obligations have not yet settled, the amounts available to settle of
such Collateral Obligations.</P>

state or other law relating to a bankruptcy naming a Borrower Entity as debtor or other initiation of bankruptcy or insolvency proceedings
by or against a Borrower Entity, or otherwise seek, with respect to a Borrower Entity, relief under any laws relating to the relief from
debts or the protection of debtors generally; (b)&nbsp;seek or consent to the appointment of a receiver, liquidator, conservator, assignee,
trustee, sequestrator, custodian or any similar official for a Borrower Entity or all or any portion of its properties; (c)&nbsp;make
or consent to any assignment for the benefit of a Borrower Entity&rsquo;s creditors generally; (d)&nbsp;admit in writing the inability
of a Borrower Entity to pay its debts generally as they become due; (e)&nbsp;petition for or consent to substantive consolidation of
a Borrower Entity with any other person; (f)&nbsp;amend or alter or otherwise modify or remove all or any part of Section&nbsp;7.2, Section&nbsp;7.5
or Section&nbsp;7.6 of the Constitutive Documents of the Borrower (as defined therein) or any similar provision of the Constitutive Documents
of any other Borrower Entity; or (g)&nbsp;amend, alter or otherwise modify or remove all or any part of the definition of &ldquo;Independent
Manager&rdquo; or the definition of &ldquo;Material Action&rdquo; (or any similar or analogous term or provision) in the Constitutive
Documents of any Borrower Entity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Material Adverse
Effect</B>&rdquo; means a material adverse effect on and/or material adverse developments with respect to (a)&nbsp;the business, operations,
properties, assets or financial condition of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries taken as a whole; (b)&nbsp;the ability of any Credit Party
to fully and timely perform its Obligations; (c)&nbsp;the legality, validity, binding effect or enforceability against a Credit Party
of a Transaction Document to which it is a party; or (d)&nbsp;the rights, remedies and benefits available to, or conferred upon, any
Agent, any Lender or any other Secured Party under any Transaction Document.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Material Amendment</B>&rdquo;
means an Amendment that would reasonably be expect to (a)&nbsp;have a material adverse effect on (1)&nbsp;the business, operations, properties,
assets or financial condition of the related obligors; (2)&nbsp;the ability of the related obligors to fully and timely perform their
obligations; (3)&nbsp;the legality, validity, binding effect or enforceability against the related Underlying Instruments (taken as whole);
(4)&nbsp;the rights, remedies and benefits available to, or conferred upon, any agent, any lender or any other secured party under the
related Underlying Instruments (taken as whole); or (5)&nbsp;the ability of or price at which the Borrower or other holder thereof may
sell, participate or otherwise transfer the related Collateral Obligation; (b)&nbsp;waive, reduce or otherwise materially modify terms
and conditions under the Underlying Instruments relating to the financial performance of the related obligor or material operational
covenants of the related obligor; (c)&nbsp;result in the related Collateral Obligation failing to satisfy any of the elements in the
definition of &ldquo;Collateral Obligation&rdquo;; or (d)&nbsp;result in a Material Modification, Material Modification (Advance Rate)
or other Value Adjustment Event.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>all
written information describing the terms of amendments, waivers, modifications or supplements to any Underlying Instrument governing

of each executed or agreed amendment, waiver, modification and supplement to such Underlying Instruments.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Material Contract</B>&rdquo;
means any contract or other arrangement to which any Borrower Entity is a party (other than the Transaction Documents) for which breach,
nonperformance, cancellation or failure to renew would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Material Modification</B>&rdquo; means
any Amendment with respect to a Collateral Obligation that, in the determination of the Calculation Agent, has the effect of:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>waiving
the payment of cash interest or permitting any cash interest to be &ldquo;paid in kind,&rdquo; deferred or capitalized and added to the
principal amount of such Collateral Obligation, or amending or modifying the terms of such Collateral Obligation to permit &ldquo;payment
in kind&rdquo;, deferral or capitalization in the future;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>delaying
or extending the maturity date or the date of any scheduled or mandatory principal payment or amortization schedule;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>modifying
the interest rate thereon (excluding any modification of an interest rate arising (i)&nbsp;by operation of a default or penalty interest
clause in the related Underlying Instruments for such Collateral Obligation, or (ii)&nbsp;pursuant to a contractual pricing grid set
forth in the related Underlying Instruments, in each case, pursuant to the Underlying Instruments for such Loan Obligation in effect
as at the time the Acquisition of such Collateral Obligation);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>reducing
or forgiving any or all of the principal thereof or interest thereon;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in">(e)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>amending,
waiving, forbearing, supplementing or otherwise modifying in any way any financial covenant or provision with respect to permitted liens,
changing any defined term materiality determinative in the calculation of a financial covenant (or related ratios) (including, but not
limited to, the calculations of any Value Adjustment Events), or changing definitions relating to leverage, permitted liens or any other
defined term in each case in a manner that is materially adverse to the rights and remedies of the Lenders;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in">(f)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>resulting
in any less financial information in respect of reporting frequency, scope or otherwise being provided with respect to the related obligor
or reduces the frequency or total number of any appraisals required thereunder, unless approved by the Calculation Agent; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in">(g)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>waiving,
amending or forbearing a default or an event of default or a covenant breach under the Underlying Instruments governing such Collateral
Obligation or waiving, amending, forbearing or otherwise modifying the related grace periods in each case in a manner that is materially

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Material Modification (Advance Rate)</B>&rdquo;
means any Amendment with respect to a Collateral Obligation that, in the reasonable determination of the Calculation Agent, has the effect
of:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>contractually or structurally subordinating such Collateral Obligation;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>substituting,
altering or releasing any or all of the underlying assets securing such Collateral Obligation, and such substitution, alteration or release
materially and adversely affects the value of such Collateral Obligation; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>amending
or waiving any provision related to the exercise or availability of creditors remedies under any Underlying Instrument with respect to
the Collateral Obligation in a manner that is materially adverse to the rights and remedies of the Lenders (or availability thereof).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>maturity</B>&rdquo;
means, with respect to any Collateral Obligation, the date on which such obligation shall be deemed to mature (or its maturity date),
which shall be the earlier of (a)&nbsp;the Stated Maturity of such obligation and (b)&nbsp;if a Borrower Entity has a right to require
the issuer or obligor of such Collateral Obligation to purchase, redeem or retire such Collateral Obligation (at par) on any one or more
dates prior to its Stated Maturity (a &ldquo;<B>put right</B>&rdquo;) and the Collateral Manager determines that it shall exercise such
put right on any such date, the maturity date shall be the date specified in a certification provided to the Collateral Agent, the Administrative
Agent and Collateral Administrator.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Maturity Date</B>&rdquo;
means the earlier of (a)&nbsp;the Scheduled Maturity Date and (b)&nbsp;the date on which all Loans shall become due and payable in full
hereunder, whether by acceleration or otherwise.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Maximum Facility
Amount</B>&rdquo; means, at any date, (a)&nbsp;$150,000,000 <I>plus</I> (b)&nbsp;the aggregate amount of New Commitments that have become
effective after the Closing Date and on or prior to such date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Minimum Obligor Event</B>&rdquo;
means, at any time, if the number of unique unaffiliated obligors of Collateral Obligations is less than 8.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Monetary Default</B>&rdquo;
means a default by a party in the payment of money (other than ordinary course expense reimbursements) when due under a contractual arrangement
(determined without regard to any grace period otherwise specified other than any grace period provided solely for administrative or
ministerial error), or a default by such party in the performance or observance of any other obligation thereunder (determined without
regard to any grace period otherwise specified) that by its terms can be cured solely by the payment of money, that with the giving of
notice or lapse of time or both, would become an event of default with respect to such party.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>money</B>&rdquo;
is defined in the UCC.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Monthly Interim Distribution
Date</B>&rdquo; means, with respect to each calendar month (other than in a month in which a Payment Date falls); any single Business
Day in such a calendar month (unless otherwise approved by the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Monthly Report</B>&rdquo;
is defined in Section&nbsp;6.5(b).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Moody&rsquo;s</B>&rdquo;
means Moody&rsquo;s Investors Service,&nbsp;Inc.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 1in"><B>&ldquo;N-Value</B>&rdquo; means, as of any date
of determination, the quotient of (a)&nbsp;the aggregate Adjusted Balance of all Collateral Obligations in the Collateral Portfolio,
squared, divided by (b)&nbsp;the sum of the Squared Adjusted Balances in respect of each unique, unaffiliated obligor in the Collateral
Portfolio. For purposes of this formula, &quot;Squared Adjusted Balance&quot; shall mean, with respect to any unique, unaffiliated obligor,
the aggregate Adjusted Balance of all Collateral Obligations of such obligor as of such time, squared.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

of each Credit Party, including obligations from time to time owed to the Agents (including former Agents), the Bank Parties, the Lenders
or any of them, under any Transaction Document, whether for principal, interest (including interest which, but for the filing of a petition
in bankruptcy with respect to such Credit Party, would have accrued on any Obligation, whether or not a claim is allowed against such
Credit Party for such interest in the related bankruptcy proceeding), Ancillary Amounts, Agent Fees, other fees, expenses, indemnification
or otherwise.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Observable Market

to qualify as a regulated investment company, and to otherwise eliminate federal or state income or excise taxes payable by the Equity
Holder in or with respect to any taxable year of the Equity Holder (or any calendar year, as relevant); <I>provided</I> that (A)&nbsp;the
amount of any such payments made in or with respect to any such taxable year (or calendar year, as relevant) of the Equity Holder shall
not exceed 115.0% of the amounts that the Borrower would have been required to distribute to the Equity Holder to: (i)&nbsp;allow each
Borrower Entity to satisfy the minimum distribution requirements that would be imposed by Section&nbsp;852(a)&nbsp;of the Code (or any
successor thereto) to maintain its eligibility to be taxed as a regulated investment company for any such taxable year, (ii)&nbsp;reduce
to zero for any such taxable year each Borrower Entity&rsquo;s liability for federal income taxes imposed on (x)&nbsp;its investment
company taxable income pursuant to Section&nbsp;852(b)(1)&nbsp;of the Code (or any successor thereto) or (y)&nbsp;its net capital gain
pursuant to Section&nbsp;852(b)(3)&nbsp;of the Code (or any successor thereto), and (iii)&nbsp;reduce to zero each Borrower Entity&rsquo;s
liability for federal excise taxes for any such calendar year imposed pursuant to Section&nbsp;4982 of the Code (or any successor thereto),
in the case of each of the foregoing clauses (i), (ii)&nbsp;or (iii), calculated assuming that each Borrower Entity had qualified to
be taxed as a regulated investment company under the Code, (B)&nbsp;after the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default,
all such distributions (other than distributions pursuant to the Enforcement Priority of Payments) shall be prohibited unless otherwise
consented to by the Administrative Agent in its reasonable discretion, and (C)&nbsp;to the extent amounts are distributed pursuant to
this definition on any date that is not a Payment Date, such amounts shall not exceed the amount of then available Excess Interest Collections.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(1)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(2)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the

in the case of a related Selling Institution that does not have an investment grade rating (or is not wholly-owned by an entity that
has an investment grade rating), the Administrative Agent has consented to the Selling Institution for such Participation (such consent
not to be unreasonably withheld);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(3)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the
aggregate participation in such Collateral Obligation granted by such Selling Institution to any one or more participants does not exceed
the principal amount or commitment with respect to which such Selling Institution is a lender under such Collateral Obligation;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(4)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>such
Participation does not grant, in the aggregate, to the participant in such Participation a greater interest than such Selling Institution
holds in the Collateral Obligation that is the subject of the participation;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(5)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(6)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(7)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>such

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(8)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>such
Participation is not a sub-participation interest; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><I>provided</I> that if such Participation is

consent of the Administrative Agent for such Acquisition) that, pursuant to the terms set forth in the Transaction Documents are required

other financial assets of any obligor, including collateralized debt obligations and mortgage-backed securities.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Subordinate Interests</B>&rdquo;

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Subsidiary</B>&rdquo;
means, with respect to any Person, any corporation, partnership, limited liability company, association, joint venture or other business
entity of which more than 50% of the total voting power of shares of stock or other ownership interests entitled (without regard to the
occurrence of any contingency) to vote in the election of the Person or Persons (whether directors, managers, trustees or other Persons
performing similar functions) having the power to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies thereof is at the time
owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by that Person or one or more of the other Subsidiaries of that Person or a combination
thereof; <I>provided</I> that, in determining the percentage of ownership interests of any Person controlled by another Person, no ownership
interest in the nature of a &ldquo;qualifying share&rdquo; of the former Person shall be deemed to be outstanding.</P>

a broadly syndicated commercial loan; (2)&nbsp;has a senior facility size of $200,000,000 or greater and the related obligor has an EBITDA
for the prior twelve (12) calendar months of $50,000,000 or greater (after giving pro forma effect to any acquisition in connection therewith);
(3)&nbsp;is rated at least CCC or Caa (as applicable) by either S&amp;P or Moody&rsquo;s (or the obligor is rated by S&amp;P or Moody&rsquo;s);
and (4)&nbsp;has a LoanX liquidity score of 1-3; or (b)&nbsp;is otherwise deemed to be a Syndicated Collateral Obligation by the Administrative
Agent; <I>provided</I> that if a Collateral Obligation no longer meets the requirements to be a Syndicated Collateral Obligation, as
determined by the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion, it shall be deemed not to be a Syndicated Collateral Obligation for all
purposes hereunder.</P>

Required Equity Amount</B>&rdquo; means, with respect to each Future Funding Collateral Obligation included in the Collateral, the Dollar
Equivalent of an amount equal to:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(i)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>the

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(ii)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the
Unfunded Exposure Amount in respect of each such Future Funding Collateral Obligation included in the Collateral <I>times</I> the Asset
Current Price of such Future Funding Collateral Obligation (expressed as percentage of par) times the Advance Rate assigned to such Future
Funding Collateral Obligation, at such time;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><I>provided</I> that after

with respect to a Collateral Obligation or its related obligor, as applicable, the occurrence of any of the following, as determined
in good faith by the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion:</P>

obligor, which current assets subject to such security interest do not constitute a material portion of the obligor&rsquo;s total assets
(it being understood that such revolving lending facility may be secured on a junior lien basis by other assets of the related obligor)
and (b)&nbsp;has a Total Net Leverage Ratio for the most recent Financial Ratio Test Period not greater than 2.0x.</P>

Net Debt</B>&rdquo; and &ldquo;<B>EBITDA</B>&rdquo; shall be determined by the Calculation Agent pursuant to the terms hereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Section&nbsp;2.<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT></B></FONT><B>LOANS
AND COMMITMENTS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><B>2.1.<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>Loans
and Commitments.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Loans</U>.
During the Availability Period, subject to the terms and conditions hereof, each Lender severally agrees to make revolving loans to the
Borrower in USD (each, a &ldquo;<B>Loan</B>&rdquo; and, together with any deemed Loan pursuant to Section&nbsp;6.3(d), the &ldquo;<B>Loans</B>&rdquo;)
in an aggregate amount up to but not exceeding such Lender&rsquo;s Commitment as then in effect; <I>provided</I> that:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(1)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>after
giving effect to the making of any Loan, the Loan Amount does not exceed the lesser of (x)&nbsp;the Adjusted Maximum Facility Amount
and (y)&nbsp;the Borrowing Base at such time; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(2)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>unless
otherwise consented to by the Administrative Agent, Loans shall not occur more frequently than two times per calendar week.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">Amounts borrowed pursuant to
this <U>Section&nbsp;2.1(a)</U>&nbsp;may be repaid and reborrowed during the Availability Period. Each Lender&rsquo;s Commitment shall
terminate immediately and without further action at 6:00 p.m.&nbsp;(New York City time) on the last day of the Availability Period.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Borrowing
Mechanics for Loans.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(1)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Loans
shall be in an aggregate minimum amount equal to the Applicable Minimum Amount and, in each case, integral multiples equal to the Applicable
Integral Multiple in excess of that amount (or such lesser amount as shall constitute the entire Commitment then available).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(2)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Subject
to <U>Section&nbsp;2.1(d)</U>, whenever the Borrower desires that Lenders make Credit Extensions, the Borrower shall deliver to the Administrative
Agent (with a copy to the Collateral Agent and the Collateral Administrator) a fully executed Funding Notice no later than 12:00 noon
(New York City time) at least one (1)&nbsp;Business Day in advance of the proposed Credit Date, or such shorter period as may be agreed
by the Requisite Lenders and the Administrative Agent.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(3)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>For
each Credit Extension, the Administrative Agent shall notify the Borrower, the Collateral Agent, the Collateral Administrator and each
Lender of the principal amount of the Loans to be made and the related Facility Fee Rate that will be applicable thereto, along with
each Lender&rsquo;s respective Pro Rata Shares thereof (which Pro Rata Shares shall be equal to the Loan amount that each Lender will
be obligated to fund to the Borrower on the related Credit Date). Such notice shall be provided by the Administrative Agent with reasonable
promptness, but not later than 10:00 a.m.&nbsp;(New York City time) on such Credit Date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(4)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>For
each Credit Extension, each Lender shall make the amount of its Loans available to the Administrative Agent not later than 12:00 p.m.&nbsp;(New
York City time) on the related Credit Date by wire transfer of same day funds in USD at the principal office designated by the Administrative
Agent. Upon satisfaction or waiver of the conditions precedent specified herein, the Administrative Agent shall make the proceeds of
the Loans available to the Borrower on such Credit Date by causing an amount of same day funds received from the Lenders to be deposited
in the Principal Collection Account or as otherwise agreed between the Borrower and the Administrative Agent, in each case for application
of such proceeds in accordance with <U>Section&nbsp;2.3</U> or as otherwise agreed between the Administrative Agent and the Borrower.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(5)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>If
a funding does not occur on any Credit Date because any condition precedent to such requested borrowing herein specified has not been
met or not all Lenders have made their respective Loans on such date, then the Administrative Agent shall return any amounts received
to the respective Lenders without interest.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>[Reserved]</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Notices</U>.
Each Funding Notice shall be executed by an Authorized Officer of the Borrower in a writing delivered to the Administrative Agent. In
lieu of delivering a Funding Notice, the Borrower may give Administrative Agent telephonic notice by the required time of any proposed
borrowing; <I>provided</I> that each such notice shall be promptly confirmed in writing by delivery of the applicable Funding Notice
to the Administrative Agent on or before the close of business on the date that the telephonic notice is given; <I>provided</I> that
a Funding Notice for all Loans made on the Initial Credit Date may, in the Administrative Agent&rsquo;s sole and absolute discretion,
be deemed to have been provided by other documentation satisfactory to the Administrative Agent. In the event of a discrepancy between
the telephone notice and the written Funding Notice, the written Funding Notice shall govern. Neither the Administrative Agent nor any
Lender shall incur any liability to the Borrower in acting upon any telephonic notice referred to above that the Administrative Agent
believes in good faith to have been given by a duly authorized officer or other person authorized on behalf of the Borrower or for otherwise
acting in good faith.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(e)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Commitment
Increases.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(1)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Borrower may, by written notice to the Administrative Agent given during the Availability Period (in the form attached as <U>Exhibit&nbsp;E</U>
hereto), from time to time request an increase to the existing Commitments (any such increase, &ldquo;<B>New Commitments</B>&rdquo;)
by an amount not less than U.S.$25,000,000 in the case of each such increase (or such lesser amount which shall be approved by the Administrative
Agent), and integral multiples of U.S.$1,000,000 in excess of that amount. Each such notice shall specify the date (each, an &ldquo;<B>Increased
Amount Date</B>&rdquo;) on which the Borrower proposes that the New Commitments be effective, which shall be a date not less than ten
(10)&nbsp;Business Days after the date on which such notice is delivered to the Administrative Agent or such shorter period of time as
consented to by the Administrative Agent. Each such New Commitment shall be subject to consent of the Administrative Agent and the Lenders
in their sole and absolute discretion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(2)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>Such
New Commitments shall become effective as of such Increased Amount Date, <I>provided</I> that (A)&nbsp;the Administrative Agent and the
Lenders shall have consented to such New Commitments in their sole and absolute discretion; (B)&nbsp;no Default or Event of Default shall
exist on such Increased Amount Date before or after giving effect to such New Commitments; (C)&nbsp;each of the conditions set forth
in Section&nbsp;3.2 shall be satisfied as if such Increased Amount Date were a Credit Date; (D)&nbsp;the Borrower shall make any payments
required pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.7 and the Fee Letters in connection with such New Commitments; and (E)&nbsp;the Borrower shall deliver
or cause to be delivered any legal opinions or other documents reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent in connection with any
such transaction.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(3)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>On
any Increased Amount Date on which New Commitments are effected, subject to the satisfaction of the foregoing terms and conditions, (A)&nbsp;each
New Commitment shall be deemed for all purposes a &ldquo;Commitment&rdquo; and each Loan made thereunder (a &ldquo;<B>New Loan</B>&rdquo;)
shall be deemed, for all purposes, a &ldquo;Loan&rdquo;. The terms and provisions of the New Commitments shall be identical to the terms
and conditions of the Commitments, and the terms and conditions of the New Loans shall be identical to the terms and conditions of the
Loans.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><B>2.2.<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>Pro
Rata Shares; Availability of Funds</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Pro
Rata Shares</U>. All Loans shall be made by Lenders simultaneously and proportionately to their respective Pro Rata Shares, it being
understood that no Lender shall be responsible for any default by any other Lender in such other Lender&rsquo;s obligation to make a
Loan requested hereunder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Availability
of Funds</U>. Unless the Administrative Agent shall have been notified by any Lender prior to the applicable Credit Date that such Lender
does not intend to make available to the Administrative Agent the amount of such Lender&rsquo;s Loan requested on such Credit Date, the
Administrative Agent may assume that such Lender has made such amount available to the Administrative Agent on such Credit Date and the
Administrative Agent may, in its sole discretion, but shall not be obligated to, make available to the Borrower a corresponding amount
on such Credit Date. If the Administrative Agent has made such corresponding amount available to the Borrower but such corresponding
amount is not in fact made available to the Administrative Agent by such Lender, then the Administrative Agent shall be entitled to recover
such corresponding amount on demand from such Lender together with interest thereon, for each day from such Credit Date until the date
such amount is paid to the Administrative Agent, at the customary rate set by the Administrative Agent for the correction of errors among
banks for three (3)&nbsp;Business Days and thereafter at the Base Rate. If such Lender does not pay such corresponding amount forthwith
upon the Administrative Agent&rsquo;s demand therefor, the Administrative Agent shall promptly notify the Borrower and the Borrower shall
on or prior to the next Payment Date pay such corresponding amount to the Administrative Agent together with interest thereon, for each
day from such Credit Date until the date such amount is paid to the Administrative Agent, at the interest rate otherwise payable hereunder.
If (1)&nbsp;the Administrative Agent declines to make a requested amount available to the Borrower until such time as all applicable
Lenders have made payment to the Administrative Agent, (2)&nbsp;a Lender fails to fund to the Administrative Agent all or any portion
of the Loans required to be funded by such Lender hereunder prior to the time specified in this Agreement and (3)&nbsp;such Lender&rsquo;s
failure results in the Administrative Agent failing to make a corresponding amount available to the Borrower on the applicable Credit
Date, then such Lender shall not receive interest hereunder with respect to the requested amount of such Lender&rsquo;s Loans for the
period commencing with the time specified in this Agreement for receipt of payment by the Borrower through and including the time of
the Borrower&rsquo;s receipt of the requested amount and the Borrower shall have no obligation to pay interest on any amounts not so
advanced. Nothing in this Section&nbsp;2.2(b)&nbsp;shall be deemed to relieve any Lender from its obligation to fulfill its Commitments
hereunder or to prejudice any rights that the Borrower may have against any Lender as a result of any default by such Lender hereunder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><B>2.3.<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>Use
of Proceeds.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">The proceeds of the Loans made
hereunder shall be used solely:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>subject
in each case to the Constitutive Documents of the Guarantor Entities, to Acquire Collateral Obligations (and, pending such Acquisitions,
to deposit funds into the Principal Collection Account);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>to
fund the Borrower&rsquo;s payment of the costs and expenses payable hereunder and under the Fee Letters (including the Upfront Fees payable
on each Credit Date);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>to
fund the Unfunded Reserve Account and Future Funding Collateral Obligations; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>to
make Permitted RIC Distributions to the Equity Holder, <I>provided</I> that the Borrower has provided the Interim Distribution Information
to the Administrative Agent;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><I>provided</I> that, any fundings of Future
Funding Collateral Obligations shall be made using, first, amounts on deposit in the Unfunded Reserve Account (in an amount equal to
the amount on deposit therein with respect to such Future Funding Collateral Obligation), second, using available Principal Proceeds,
then third, using deposits by the Borrower of cash from other sources, and then, solely upon receipt by the Administrative Agent of evidence
that the relevant Unfunded Reserve Required Equity Amount has been funded, by borrowing of Loans under Section&nbsp;2 in compliance with
this Agreement (to the extent available hereunder).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><B>2.4.<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>Evidence
of Debt; Register; Lenders&rsquo; Books and Records; Notes.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Lenders&rsquo;
Evidence of Debt</U>. Each Lender shall maintain on its internal records an account or accounts evidencing the Obligations of the Borrower
to such Lender, including the amounts and currencies of the Loans made by it and each repayment and prepayment in respect thereof. Any
such recordation shall be conclusive and binding on the Borrower, absent manifest error; <I>provided</I> that (1)&nbsp;the failure to
make any such recordation, or any error in such recordation, shall not affect the Borrower&rsquo;s Obligations in respect of any applicable
Loans; and (2)&nbsp;in the event of any inconsistency between the Register and any Lender&rsquo;s records, the recordations in the Register
shall govern.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Register</U>.
The Administrative Agent (or its agent or sub-agent appointed by it) shall maintain at its Principal Office a register for the recordation
of the names and addresses of the Lenders, and principal amounts of (and stated interest) on the Loans owing to, each Lender pursuant
to the terms hereof from time to time (the &ldquo;<B>Register</B>&rdquo;). The Borrower, the Administrative Agent and the applicable
Lenders shall treat each Person whose name is recorded in the Register pursuant to the terms hereof as a Lender hereunder for all purposes
of this Agreement. The Register shall be available for inspection by the Borrower or any Lender (with respect to (1)&nbsp;any entry relating
to such Lender&rsquo;s Loans and (2)&nbsp;the identity of the other Lenders (but not any information with respect to such other Lenders&rsquo;
Loans)) at any reasonable time and from time to time upon reasonable prior notice. The Administrative Agent shall record, or shall cause
to be recorded, in the Register the Loans in accordance with the provisions of Section&nbsp;11.6, and each repayment or prepayment in
respect of the principal amount of the Loans, and any such recordation shall be conclusive and binding on the Borrower and each Lender,
absent manifest error; <I>provided</I> that failure to make any such recordation, or any error in such recordation, shall not affect
any Lender&rsquo;s Commitments or the Borrower&rsquo;s Obligations in respect of any Loan. The Borrower hereby designates the Administrative
Agent to serve as the Borrower&rsquo;s non-fiduciary agent solely for purposes of maintaining the Register as provided in this <U>Section&nbsp;2.4</U>,
and the Borrower hereby agrees that, to the extent the Administrative Agent serves in such capacity, the Administrative Agent and its
officers, directors, employees, agents, sub-agents and affiliates shall constitute &ldquo;Indemnitees&rdquo;.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Notes</U>.
If so requested by any Lender by written notice to the Borrower (with a copy to the Administrative Agent) at least two (2)&nbsp;Business
Days prior to the Closing Date, or at any time thereafter, the Borrower shall execute and deliver to such Lender (and/or, if applicable
and if so specified in such notice, to any Person who is an assignee of such Lender pursuant to <U>Section&nbsp;11.6</U>) on the Closing
Date (or, if such notice is delivered after the Closing Date, promptly after the Borrower&rsquo;s receipt of such notice) a Note or Notes
to evidence such Lender&rsquo;s Loans. If Notes are delivered to any Lender, the Borrower may establish commercially reasonable procedures
for replacing lost or stolen Notes.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><B>2.5.<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>Interest
on Loans.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Interest
Accruals</U>. Except as otherwise set forth herein, and subject to Section&nbsp;2.5(b)&nbsp;below, each Loan shall bear interest on the
unpaid principal amount thereof from the date made through repayment (whether by acceleration or otherwise) thereof at the Facility Fee
Rate for each intervening Interest Period (in relation to each Loan and each Interest Period the &ldquo;<B>Base Accrued Interest</B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>[Reserved].</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Interest
Rate Determinations and Payments</U>. On each Payment Date, the Borrower shall pay to Collateral Agent for distribution to the Lenders
an amount equal to the sum of the Base Accrued Interest amounts determined in relation to each Loan for the related Payment Period (the
&ldquo;<B>Accrued Interest</B>&rdquo;), in accordance with the Priority of Payments. As soon as practicable after 10:00 a.m.&nbsp;(New
York City time) on each Interest Rate Determination Date, the Administrative Agent shall determine (which determination shall, absent
manifest error, be final, conclusive and binding upon all parties) the interest rates that shall apply to the Loans for which an interest
rate is then being determined for the applicable Interest Period (including the amounts set forth under clauses (a)&nbsp;and (b)&nbsp;above),
and shall promptly give notice thereof to the Borrower, the Collateral Agent, the Collateral Administrator and each Lender.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Day-Count
Fractions, Etc.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(1)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Interest
payable pursuant to <U>Section&nbsp;2.5(a)</U>&nbsp;shall be computed on the basis of a 360-day year, in each case for the actual number
of days elapsed in the period during which it accrues, except that any interest accruing at a Base Rate shall be computed on the basis
of a 365-day year. In computing interest on any Loan, the date of the making of such Loan or the first day of an Interest Period applicable
to such Loan shall be included, and the date of payment of such Loan or the expiration date of an Interest Period applicable to such
Loan shall be excluded; <I>provided</I> that, if a Loan is repaid on the same day on which it is made, one day&rsquo;s interest shall
be paid on that Loan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(2)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Except
as otherwise set forth herein, interest on each Loan shall accrue on a daily basis and shall be payable in arrears on each Payment Date,
upon any prepayment of that Loan, whether voluntary or mandatory, to the extent accrued on the amount being prepaid and at maturity of
the Loans, including final maturity of the Loans, in each case in accordance with the Priority of Payments or otherwise as expressly
provided herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(3)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>All
calculations of interest payable pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.5(a)&nbsp;shall be rounded to the nearest cent.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><B>2.6.<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>Default
Interest.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">Immediately upon the occurrence
and during the continuance of an Event of Default described in clause (e)&nbsp;or (f)&nbsp;of the definition thereof, or with respect
to any other Event of Default, upon written notice from the Administrative Agent, the principal amount of all Loans then outstanding
and, to the extent permitted by applicable law, any interest thereon, and all Ancillary Amounts owing hereunder, shall bear interest
(including post-petition interest in any proceeding under Debtor Relief Laws) payable on demand at a rate that is 2.0% <I>per annum </I>in
excess of the interest rate otherwise payable hereunder with respect to the Loans. Payment or acceptance of the increased rates of interest
provided for in this Section&nbsp;2.6 is not a permitted alternative to timely payment and shall not in and of itself constitute a waiver
of any Event of Default or otherwise prejudice or limit any rights or remedies of any Secured Party.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><B>2.7.<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>Ancillary
Amounts; Etc.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Agent
Fees</U>. The Borrower has agreed to pay to the Agents such fees (the &ldquo;<B>Agent Fees</B>&rdquo;), in the amounts and on the dates,
as are set forth in the Agent Fee Letters.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Commitment
Fees</U>. The Borrower agrees to pay to the Administrative Agent for the pro rata benefit of the Lenders non-utilization fees and minimum
spread fees (the &ldquo;<B>Commitment Fees</B>&rdquo;) in the amounts set forth in the Commitment Fee Letter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Upfront
Fees</U>. The Borrower shall pay to each Lender, on the Closing Date, a fee (the &ldquo;<B>Upfront Fee</B>&rdquo;) in the amount set
forth in the GS Fee Letter as the &ldquo;<B>Upfront Fee</B>&rdquo;. Such Upfront Fee will be in all respects fully earned and due and
payable on the Closing Date, and non-refundable and non-creditable thereafter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Make-Whole
Payments</U>. On each date on which a Make-Whole Event occurs, the Borrower shall pay to the Lenders the related Make-Whole Amount. The
Make-Whole Amount shall be payable pursuant to the Priority of Payments or as otherwise expressly stated herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Make-Whole Amount</B>&rdquo;
means, with respect to each Make-Whole Event that occurs on or prior to the Make-Whole Toggle Date, the product of (a)&nbsp;the Make-Whole

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Make-Whole Calculation

or (ii)&nbsp;the Loan Amount at the time of such acceleration, as applicable.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Make-Whole Event</B>&rdquo;
means each of the following:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>each
partial Voluntary Commitment Reduction;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>the
acceleration of the Loans and other Obligations pursuant to Section&nbsp;9 in connection with an Event of Default; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>each
Voluntary Commitment Reduction that reduces the Commitments of the Lenders to zero;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">in each case occurring prior to the Make-Whole
Toggle Date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Make-Whole Premium
Percentage</B>&rdquo; means 1.0%</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&ldquo;<B>Make-Whole Toggle
Date</B>&rdquo; means the day following the 18<SUP>th</SUP> calendar month anniversary of the Closing Date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><B>2.8.<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>Prepayments;
Voluntary Commitment Reductions.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(a)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Voluntary
Prepayments.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(1)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Any
time and from time to time, the Borrower may prepay any Loans on any Business Day in whole or in part (each, a &ldquo;<B>Voluntary Prepayment</B>&rdquo;),
in an aggregate minimum amount not less than the Applicable Minimum Amount and integral multiples in excess of that amount equal to the
related Applicable Integral Multiple; <I>provided</I> that:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(x)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>unless
the Loan will be paid in full as a result of such Voluntary Prepayment, no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing
or would result therefrom; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(y)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>sufficient
amounts are on deposit in the Principal Collection Account to pay the principal of the Loans to be prepaid together with the other amounts
that will be owing in connection therewith (including any related Make-Whole Amount).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(2)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>All
such prepayments shall be made, upon not less than three (3)&nbsp;Business Days (or such shorter period as the Administrative Agent may
agree) prior written or telephonic notice in advance of the proposed Voluntary Prepayment date, in each case given to the Administrative
Agent (with a copy to the Collateral Agent and the Collateral Administrator) by 12:00 p.m.&nbsp;(New York City time) on the date of such
prepayment and, if given by telephone, promptly confirmed by delivery of written notice thereof to the Administrative Agent (and the
Administrative Agent will promptly transmit a copy of such written notice to each Lender). Each notice of a Voluntary Prepayment shall
specify the principal amount to be prepaid and the related prepayment date (which shall be a Business Day). Upon the giving of any such
notice, the principal amount of the Loans specified in such notice shall become due and payable on the prepayment date specified therein.
Notwithstanding the foregoing, any Voluntary Prepayment made in respect of a Borrowing Base Breach Repayment shall be made in accordance
with the provisions and timing set forth in Exhibit&nbsp;B.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(b)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Voluntary
Commitment Reductions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(1)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>the
Borrower may, upon not less than five (5)&nbsp;Business Days prior written notice to the Administrative Agent (which written notice the
Administrative Agent will promptly transmit by electronic means to each applicable Lender), at any time and from time to time, terminate
in whole or permanently reduce in part the Commitments in an amount up to the amount by which the Commitments exceed the Loan Amount
at the time of such proposed termination or reduction (each, a &ldquo;<B>Voluntary Commitment Reduction</B>&rdquo;); <I>provided</I>
that:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(x)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>any
such partial reduction of the Commitments shall be in an aggregate minimum amount of $5,000,000 and integral multiples of $1,000,000
in excess of that amount;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(y)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>unless
the Commitments will be terminated in whole, no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing or would result therefrom;
and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(z)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT>sufficient
amounts are on deposit in the Principal Collection Account to pay the other amounts that will be owing in connection therewith (including
any related Make-Whole Amounts).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">(2)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Borrower&rsquo;s notice to the Administrative Agent shall designate the date (which shall be a Business Day) of such termination or reduction
and the amount of any partial reduction, and such termination or reduction of the Commitments shall be effective on the date specified
in the Borrower&rsquo;s notice and shall reduce the Commitment of each Lender proportionately to its pro rata share thereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(c)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Other
Amounts</U>. Each payment of principal of the Loans in connection with a Voluntary Prepayment shall be accompanied by payment of any
related Make-Whole Amounts (if applicable), the amount of accrued interest on the portion of the Loans so prepaid and (if such payment
is made other than on the last day of an interest period) any related breakage costs payable under <U>Section&nbsp;2.13(c)</U>. Each
Voluntary Commitment Reduction shall be accompanied by payment of the related Make-Whole Amounts (if applicable).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(d)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Non-Waterfall
Payments</U>. Voluntary Prepayments (including any Borrowing Base Breach Repayment) and payment of amounts under clause (c)&nbsp;above
shall not be subject to the Priority of Payments but instead shall be made solely out of Principal Proceeds or Interest Proceeds then
on deposit in the Collection Account; <I>provided</I> that Interest Proceeds shall not be applied to make Voluntary Prepayments or pay
amounts under clause (c)&nbsp;above unless, after giving effect to such payment, there shall be sufficient Interest Proceeds available
in the Interest Collection Account to make all payments of interest in accordance with the Priority of Payments on the next Payment Date,
with any remaining unpaid amounts to be paid out of Principal Proceeds and Interest Proceeds thereafter received in the Transaction Accounts
until paid in full, and all amounts that continue to be owing on and after the next Payment Date shall be payable under the Priority
of Payments.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(e)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT><U>Payable
Immediately</U>. The Make-Whole Amount shall be payable immediately in accordance with <U>Sections 2.8(c)</U>&nbsp;and <U>2.8(d)</U>&nbsp;and
otherwise pursuant to the Priority of Payments or as otherwise expressly stated herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">(f)<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&nbsp;</FONT><U>Minimum
Diversity</U>. If at any time during the Reinvestment Period, but following the expiration of the Ramp-up Period (x)&nbsp;either (i)&nbsp;the
number of unique unaffiliated obligors of Collateral Obligations is less than 20 or (ii)&nbsp;the N-Value falls below 20, then, in each
case, the Administrative Agent and the Requisite Lenders may elect to deliver notice (such notice, the &ldquo;<B>Minimum Diversity Event
Notice</B>&rdquo;) to the Borrower (with a copy to the Collateral Agent and the Collateral Administrator) that the Reinvestment Period
shall end and the Amortization Period commence on the date that is 3 months after delivery of such Minimum Diversity Event Notice (a
&ldquo;<B>Minimum Diversity Event</B>&rdquo;), unless (i)&nbsp;no previous Minimum Diversity Event has occurred and been cured and (ii)&nbsp;the
number of unique unaffiliated obligors of Collateral Obligations becomes both (A)&nbsp;greater than or equal to 20 and (B)&nbsp;the N-Value
is at least 20 prior to the date that is 3 months after delivery of such first Minimum Diversity Event Notice. For the avoidance of doubt
if the Reinvestment Period is terminated pursuant to this clause (f)&nbsp;it shall not be reinstated.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
